name: inkscape-mcp
description: Headless Inkscape SVG automation via FastMCP: create/edit vector graphics, layers, animation, LPEs, gradients/patterns, XML editing, text-on-path, filters, and fleet handoff to GIMP/Blender/Unity/Resonite. Includes online extension-gallery search/install and AI-assisted SVG generation.

inkscape_path.title: Inkscape Executable Path
inkscape_path.description: Path to the Inkscape executable on your system

process_timeout.title: Operation Timeout (seconds)
process_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for Inkscape operations to complete

max_concurrent_processes.title: Max Concurrent Operations
max_concurrent_processes.description: Maximum number of concurrent Inkscape processes allowed

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Working Directories (comma-separated)
allowed_directories.description: Comma-separated list of directories where file operations are permitted

tools.name: inkscape_file
tools.description: File operations: load, convert, info, validate, list_formats

tools.name: inkscape_vector
tools.description: Vector editing: primitives, booleans, LPEs, gradients/patterns, XML get/set-attributes, text-on-path, flow-text, symbols, trace, QR/barcode, filters (blur/drop_shadow/glow), bulk restyle by CSS-like selector

tools.name: inkscape_layers
tools.description: Layer management: list, create, rename, hide/show, lock/unlock, reorder

tools.name: inkscape_animation
tools.description: SMIL/CSS animation: presets (bounce, fade, slide, rotate, pulse, shake) plus raw animate/transform/motion/color

tools.name: inkscape_analysis
tools.description: Document analysis: statistics, validate, dimensions, structure, quality

tools.name: inkscape_render
tools.description: Agent-vision PNG exports and document summaries for vision-loop workflows

tools.name: inkscape_validation
tools.description: SVG QA checks: viewBox, stroke/fill, size limits, web-export best practices

tools.name: inkscape_fleet
tools.description: Cross-repo handoff: push renders to GIMP, stage SVGs for Blender, export Unity sprites

tools.name: inkscape_fab_art
tools.description: DXF/laser fab paths and Gazebo robotics schematic staging

tools.name: inkscape_sim_art
tools.description: Icon packs, sprite sheets, and Resonite/VRChat UI asset staging

tools.name: inkscape_system
tools.description: Server/Inkscape status, diagnostics, version, config, and online extension-gallery search/install/uninstall

tools.name: generate_svg
tools.description: Natural-language SVG generation via client LLM sampling, with Inkscape post-processing

tools.name: generate_heraldry
tools.description: Heraldic coat-of-arms SVG generation from preset compositions

tools.name: list_local_models
tools.description: Discover local Ollama / LM Studio model IDs

tools.name: llm_ops
tools.description: Manage the local LLM engine: list/switch/unload models, VRAM telemetry

tools.name: agentic_inkscape_workflow
tools.description: Autonomous multi-step Inkscape workflows via client-side LLM sampling

tools.name: conversational_inkscape_assistant
tools.description: Conversational multi-step assistant over the vector-editing tool surface

tools.name: intelligent_vector_processing
tools.description: Batch SVG/vector processing driven by client-side LLM sampling
